translations.web: Then again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
translations.bsb: Again I lifted up my eyes and saw before me a flying scroll.
translations.kjv: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
translations.asv: Then again I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, a flying roll.
